'''Valerie Bailey''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[March 2001 Indianapolis tournament]] on 17 March 2001 with [[Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|Carbon Chamber Testing]], according to Eric Bailey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1917">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-19-indianapolis-in-3-17-01d1917/ indianapolis-in-3-17-01], DeckTech (Eric "YOYOY" Bailey, 19 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-19-indianapolis-in-3-17-01d1917/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
